# kion_gcp_account (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a Kion GcpAccount by id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kion_gcp_account" "example" {
  # Required
  id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) The ID of the GcpAccount to fetch.

### Read-Only

- `account_alias` (String)
- `account_name` (String)
- `account_type_id` (Number)
- `payer_id` (Number)
- `project_id` (Number)
- `skip_access_checking` (Boolean)
- `start_datecode` (String)
